*   `?g A4`: Main Concept is Fauna / Animal.
    *   `+ C3`: (Cube in group g) Slow / Slow motion.
    *   `+ Brown`: (Cube in group g) Brown.
    *   `+ H10`: (Cube in group g) Small / Low.
    *   `+ G3`: (Cube in group g) Spiral / Drunkenness / Coil.

    *   Animal + Slow + Brown + Small + Spiral/Coiled.

    *   Snail (Coiled shell, slow, brown/earth tones, small).
    *   Turtle (Slow, brown, but not typically spiral/coiled in the same iconic way as a snail).
    *   Sloth (Slow, brown, but not spiral/coiled).
    *   Caterpillar (Slow, brown, coiled/curled sometimes, but snail fits "spiral" better).

    *   Snail
    *   Turtle
    *   Sloth

    *   Snail fits "Spiral" (the shell) very well.
    *   "Slow" is a primary characteristic of a snail.
    *   "Brown" is a common color.
    *   "Small" is accurate.

    1. Snail
    2. Turtle
    3. Sloth
